_meta.phase: Phase 7B.4 — FIXEO Fair Price Research — Electricity Morocco
_meta.city_adjustment_note: No city multipliers applied in V0. afous.ma coefficients documented for future use: Rabat/Marrakech ×0.95, Agadir/Tanger ×0.90, Fès/Meknès/Salé ×0.85. These are external observatory values — FIXEO cannot adopt without own transaction data.
_meta.urgency_modifier_note: No urgency modifiers approved. mano.ma editorial: soir +30–50%, nuit +50–100%, weekend +40–60%, jours fériés +60–100%. Materially higher than plumbing modifiers — electricity urgency commands larger premium due to safety/risk. All remain NON-CANONICAL until FIXEO has observed transaction data.
key_structural_findings: Electricity pricing is MORE heterogeneous than plumbing — range width per service is larger
Materials cost (hardware) is a MAJOR pricing variable — unlike plumbing where consumables are minimal
Per-unit pricing (per prise/interrupteur/spot) is structurally different from flat-intervention pricing
Diagnostic fee practice: generally INCLUDED in forfait for simple interventions; SEPARATE charged for complex fault-finding (tableau, court-circuit, panne intermittente)
Tarif horaire national: 150–180 DH/h (afous.ma P30-P70, 480 relevés) — market-grounding anchor
Casablanca premium: 200–280 DH/h (mano.ma) — consistent with afous.ma ×1.00 coefficient being the reference point
Safety: several intervention types are inherently incompatible with fixed pricing — burnt wiring, tableau replacement, three-phase, complete rewiring
Best standardization candidates: prise/interrupteur remplacement, luminaire installation, disjoncteur simple remplacement (with client-supplied part)
Biggest data gap: no field-level pricing for interrupteur différentiel installation, sonnette/interphone, circuit ajout — insufficient evidence

afous_city_coefficients_documented.note: External observatory values. FIXEO cannot adopt without own transaction data validation.

artisan_economic_floor_casablanca.comment: afous.ma P30-P70 urgency hourly rate 150-180 DH, midpoint 165 DH. 30-min intervention should yield ~82 DH labour. Add travel 40 DH (MID) + commission 15% = minimum intervention price ~200–250 DH to be viable.
artisan_economic_floor_casablanca.note: Any FIXEO fixed price below 200 MAD for a genuine 30-min residential intervention in Casablanca risks artisan economic viability.

services.description: Artisan travel + on-site fault identification. Verbal findings. No repair performed.
services.candidacy_rationale: Standard practice: diagnostic is an explicit, universally charged step in Morocco. Similar to plumbing model. Scope is clearly delimitable. Good standardization candidate.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 200–500 DH for 'recherche et diagnostic'. Wide range. afous.ma does not separate diagnostic as standalone — included in urgency hourly rate. Limited direct evidence for diagnostic-only forfait.
reference_price.derivation: Lower bound from artisan economic floor (200 DH travel+30min) minus urgency component. Anchor from mano.ma midpoint adjusted for standard hours. Upper bound from mano.ma high end.

diagnostic_policy.Morocco_practice: Diagnostic fee standard in Morocco — charged even if no repair proceeds. mano.ma notes: 'diagnostic often charged separately; ensure deducted if repairs confirmed.' This is aspirational not market reality — no confirmed deductible model in electricity.

services.safety_note: Diagnostic itself is low-risk but findings may reveal DANGEROUS installations requiring immediate quote or ONRE referral.

services.description: Replacement or repair of a standard accessible electrical outlet. Part may be client-supplied or artisan-supplied.
services.candidacy_rationale: Most standardizable residential electrical intervention. Scope clearly delimitable: one accessible standard prise, replace or reconnect. Low complexity, predictable labour (20–30 min), simple hardware.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 150–300 DH for 'réparation prise'. afous.ma 70–80 DH per unit (labour only) + travel ~50–100 DH = 120–180 DH effective per single outlet when accounting for travel. Two sources with consistent direction. Midpoint 220 DH plausible for single prise intervention including travel.
reference_price.derivation: Labour per unit 70-80 DH (afous P30-P70) + travel 50-100 DH (mano.ma urban) = 120-180 DH floor. mano.ma forfait 150-300 DH. Consensus: 150-300 MAD. Part (basic prise ~20-60 DH) — for FIXEO: client-supplied policy recommended.
reference_price.unit_note: FLAT_INTERVENTION for single outlet replacement. Per-unit only applies when multiple outlets on same visit.

materials_policy.basic_consumables: wire connector, domino if needed — ≤20 MAD included
materials_policy.replacement_parts: EXCLUDED — prise/interrupteur hardware (20–80 DH retail) must be disclosed and approved, or client-supplied
materials_policy.part_supply_note: Standard prise: 20–60 DH droguerie/Bricoma. Schneider/Legrand premium: 60–120 DH. Client guidance: purchase before visit or artisan declares separately.

diagnostic_policy.note: Symptom known before arrival (prise ne fonctionne plus). Standard intervention — no separate diagnostic fee for accessible outlet.

complexity_escape_rules: Wiring behind wall found burnt or damaged — HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → DIAGNOSIS_FIRST
No accessible junction box — wall opening required → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
More than 1 outlet on different circuits → quote separately
Ground wire absent or defective → safety issue → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE + client safety warning
Prise spécialisée (four, clim, machine) → higher complexity → quote
services.safety_note: Ground wire (terre) status must be verified. If missing: safety warning mandatory. Cannot ignore absence of earth connection.

services.description: Replacement of a standard accessible wall switch, simple or two-way (va-et-vient).
services.candidacy_rationale: Identical complexity profile to prise_remplacement. 20–30 min, predictable scope, client can supply part. Same standardization level.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 80–150 DH per unit (labour) + travel. afous.ma 70–80 DH per unit. Va-et-vient mano.ma 150–250 DH — slightly more complex. For single standard interrupteur: 150–250 DH forfait. Consistent evidence from 2 sources.
reference_price.derivation: Labour 70-80 DH (afous) + travel 50-100 DH = 120-180 DH floor. mano.ma forfait 80-150 DH per unit only. For single intervention including travel: 150-250 MAD. Va-et-vient escapes to upper range.

va_et_vient_range.note: Two switching points — higher complexity than simple interrupteur

materials_policy.replacement_parts: EXCLUDED — interrupteur hardware (15–60 DH) client-supplied or artisan-disclosed
materials_policy.part_supply_note: Simple interrupteur: 15–40 DH. Schneider Unica/Legrand premium: 40–100 DH. Va-et-vient requires 2 units.

diagnostic_policy.note: Symptom clear before arrival. No separate diagnostic.

complexity_escape_rules: Multiple switches on different circuits on same visit → quote per additional
Wiring damaged behind wall → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Complex multi-way switching system → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Dimmer or smart-switch installation with programming → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE

services.description: Installation of client-supplied light fixture (plafonnier, lustre, applique). Wiring connection only.
services.candidacy_rationale: Tightly definable scope when client supplies fixture. 20–45 min depending on fixture complexity. Common residential request. Client-supplied fixture eliminates material ambiguity — same standardization logic as robinet_remplacement in plumbing.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma plafonnier simple 150–300 DH; lustre décoratif 300–600 DH. Two service types clearly differentiated. Simple fixture: 150–300 DH consistent. Lustre: 300–600 DH. For FIXEO standard scope (simple plafonnier/applique): 150–300 DH. Lustre is complexity escape.

variant_simple.note: Plafonnier simple, applique murale — client supplies fixture

variant_lustre.note: Lustre lourd ou décoratif — HORS PÉRIMÈTRE standard price

variant_spot_per_unit.note: Per spot — separate unit pricing for batch installation

materials_policy.client_label: Main-d'œuvre + déplacement — luminaire fourni par le client

diagnostic_policy.note: Standard installation — fixture provided, existing wiring used. No separate diagnostic.

complexity_escape_rules: Existing wiring defective or absent → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE — new wiring circuit required
Fixture weight >15 kg requiring structural hook → additional work → quote
Lustre with multiple drops and chains → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Installation point has no existing junction box → new saignée required → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Exterior installation requiring waterproofing → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE

services.description: Replacement of one defective single-pole circuit breaker in an accessible distribution board. Part client-supplied or artisan-declared.
services.candidacy_rationale: Tightly defined scope when restricted to single MCB in accessible tableau. 20–30 min. Predictable. However MAJOR CAUTION: diagnostics must precede — a tripping breaker may indicate underlying wiring fault, not breaker failure. FIXEO price only valid when fault confirmed as defective breaker, NOT for repeated-trip investigation.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: afous.ma 170–200 DH forfait from 480 relevés (national average). mano.ma 400–800 DH (likely includes brand-name part + labour). Reconciliation: afous.ma 170–200 is national P30-P70 likely including basic MCB. mano.ma 400–800 is urban Casablanca with better part + labour. FIXEO standard scope: labour + basic MCB (40–80 DH part), travel — consistent with 200–350 MAD range. Upper 400 DH for premium breaker or differential.
reference_price.part_note: Basic MCB 40–80 DH retail (generic). Schneider iC60/Legrand DX3: 80–200 DH. Interrupteur différentiel (ID): 150–350 DH. Part cost is MATERIAL variable — client-supplied policy strongly recommended.

materials_policy.replacement_parts: EXCLUDED — disjoncteur (40–200 DH depending on type) must be declared and approved separately OR client-supplied
materials_policy.critical_safety_note: FIXEO must NOT supply generic uncertified disjoncteurs. If artisan supplies: certified brands only (Schneider, Legrand, ABB). Part provenance must be declared.

diagnostic_policy.note: IF artisan confirms on arrival that the breaker is definitively defective (verified, not tripping due to downstream overload/fault): proceed with 1-disjoncteur replacement price. IF cause uncertain (repeated trips, overloaded circuit, suspect wiring) → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → diagnostic/investigation service.

complexity_escape_rules: Cause of breaker tripping not confirmed as defective breaker → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE — investigation service
Tableau inaccessible or locked (co-propriété, technical room) → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Tableau itself damaged (burnt, corroded) → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE — tableau diagnostic + quote
Three-phase circuit → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → specialist + quote
More than 1 breaker to replace → quote per additional or full-tableau assessment
Interrupteur différentiel (ID/RCD) → higher cost part → quote separately
Disjoncteur de branchement (main utility breaker) → requires ONEE authorization → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
services.safety_note: CANNOT replace ONEE disjoncteur de branchement — utility-owned, requires ONEE authorization. Must verify circuit identity before disconnection. Short-circuit investigation behind a tripping breaker must NEVER be given a fixed price.

services.label_fr: Dépannage panne électrique simple — cause visible
services.description: Diagnosis + repair of a simple, visible, immediately-accessible electrical fault. Cause is identified on arrival without investigation beyond visual inspection.
services.candidacy_rationale: REJECTED FOR FIXED PRICE — too heterogeneous. 'Panne simple' can be a loose wire, a tripped breaker, a burnt prise, or a defective fixture. Scope cannot be reliably pre-defined. Each case may require different parts and labour. DIAGNOSIS_FIRST architecture required.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 'diagnostic + réparation' 500–800 DH. 'Réparation prise' 150–300 DH. 'Court-circuit' 300–600 DH. Range is too wide to establish a defensible fixed price. Useful only as context range for DIAGNOSIS_FIRST pricing.
reference_price.note: Reference range for context only — confirms artisan should quote after on-site assessment.

services.pricing_note: DIAGNOSIS_FIRST: artisan visits and diagnoses (150–250 DH diagnostic fee). Then quotes repair based on actual scope.
services.safety_note: Electrical fault investigations must NEVER receive a guaranteed fixed repair price — cause is unknown until diagnosis. Scope can escalate to burnt wiring, dangerous installations.

services.description: Diagnosis and repair of a short-circuit condition.
services.candidacy_rationale: REJECTED FOR FIXED PRICE — a court-circuit has unknown root cause until diagnosed. Cause may be: accessible loose connection (simple, 30 min), buried cable fault (complex, 2–4h + wall opening), defective appliance (not electrician scope), deteriorated installation. Price range is ×4 depending on cause.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 300–600 DH for 'court-circuit simple'. But 'simple' is undefined — this is editorial assumption. Real court-circuit can far exceed this.
reference_price.note: Context range only — NOT for FIXEO fixed price.

services.pricing_note: DIAGNOSIS_FIRST: diagnostic fee (150–250 DH) + repair quote based on cause identified.
services.safety_note: Court-circuit can indicate fire risk (carbonized wiring, overloaded circuit). Must NEVER be given a simplistic fixed price. Burnt wiring requires full replacement of affected section — not a simple repair.

services.label_fr: Panne totale — perte complète du courant
services.description: Total power loss to dwelling. Root cause unknown.
services.candidacy_rationale: REJECTED — unknown root cause. Could be: tripped main breaker (2-min fix, 0 cost), ONEE cut (not electrician scope), defective main breaker (breaker replacement), wiring fault, or multiple simultaneous faults. Diagnostic is mandatory first step.
services.pricing_note: Diagnostic first (150–250 DH). Repair quoted after cause established.

services.description: Inspection and diagnosis of a distribution board — identifying defective components, sizing adequacy, safety compliance.
services.candidacy_rationale: REJECTED FOR STANDARD FIXED PRICE — tableau diagnosis complexity is highly variable. Simple inspection (30 min) vs full compliance audit (2h) are different services. However a NARROW diagnostic fee could be defined for a standardized 'tableau inspection + verbal report' scope.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 'problème tableau' 800–1500 DH — likely includes diagnosis + minor repair. No standalone tableau diagnostic price found in evidence. Insufficient data for consensus.
reference_price.note: Range is for tableau diagnostic + initial intervention, not standalone inspection only.

services.safety_note: Tableau inspection may reveal non-compliant or dangerous installation requiring immediate remediation. Artisan cannot ignore safety hazards discovered during inspection.

services.description: Complete replacement of a distribution board.
services.candidacy_rationale: PERMANENTLY REJECTED FOR FIXED PRICE — tableau replacement is a major project: part cost alone varies ×4 (1,200–5,000+ DH depending on modules, brand, type), labour 2–4h, may require ONEE coordination, earthing work, testing. Each installation is unique.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: mano.ma 4-module 1200–2000 DH; 8-module 2000–3500 DH; 12-module 3500–5000 DH. These include equipment. Useful as client budget context — not for FIXEO price. Labour-only for tableau swap: ~600–1200 DH estimated, not confirmed.
reference_price.note: Context range only (LABOUR + EQUIPMENT combined). QUOTE_REQUIRED.

services.safety_note: Tableau replacement must include: earthing verification, differential protection, circuit labelling, isolation of circuits during work, testing post-installation. Cannot be rushed or given a price without full site assessment.

services.description: Installation of a residual current device (RCD/DDR) in an existing or new distribution board.
services.candidacy_rationale: CONDITIONAL — potentially standardizable but insufficient evidence. DDR cost: 150–350 DH retail (Schneider RESI9, Legrand). Labour: 30–45 min. But requires tableau space verification, circuit compatibility check. Insufficient market data to establish reference.
services.pricing_note: Future research needed. Likely: 400–700 MAD labour + DDR part separately declared.

services.description: Adding a new dedicated circuit from the tableau to a new point (e.g., for lave-linge, four, clim).
services.candidacy_rationale: REJECTED — circuit length is unknown (10m vs 40m is ×4 in cable cost). Requires tableau space, cable path through walls/floors, new breaker, new outlet. Per-metre pricing is theoretically applicable but scope varies enormously.
services.pricing_note: Always quote on site. Rough market context: 600–1500 MAD for typical apartment circuit addition (labour + cable + breaker + prise), dependent on distance and routing complexity.

services.label_fr: Point électrique — installation prise ou interrupteur sur circuit existant
services.description: Adding a new outlet or switch on an existing circuit without a new circuit from tableau.
services.candidacy_rationale: CONDITIONAL — encastré vs saillie is a major cost differentiator. Encastré requires saignée (wall chasing) = extra labour + masonry work. Saillie (surface conduit) is much simpler. Insufficient data to separate these reliably. Future standardization possible for saillie-only.

reference_price.confidence_rationale: Per-unit data (70–80 DH afous.ma, 80–150 DH mano.ma) applies to labour only. Adding travel and basic materials: floor 150–250 DH for saillie single-point. Encastré may double the price. Insufficient to separate.

services.description: Doorbell or interphone installation or repair.
services.candidacy_rationale: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE — no external source provided pricing for sonnette/interphone specifically. Scope varies: simple battery doorbell vs wired multi-apartment interphone are completely different interventions.
services.pricing_note: Simple sonnette remplacement: ~150–300 DH estimated. Interphone système: always quote. Requires further research.

services.description: Replacement of a damaged electrical cable.
services.candidacy_rationale: REJECTED — cable length and routing are completely variable. Encastré vs saillie, length, section, accessibility all dramatically change scope. No fixed price possible.

reference_price.note: Context range only — labour + cable for a 'typical' short accessible run. QUOTE_REQUIRED for all cases.

services.label_fr: Installation électrique complète — logement neuf ou rénovation totale
services.description: Complete electrical installation of a dwelling.
services.candidacy_rationale: PERMANENTLY REJECTED — major project, always quote. Per-m² pricing exists as market reference (400–1200 DH/m² depending on standard) but this encompasses labour + all materials. FIXEO cannot price this.

reference_price.note: Per m² includes ALL labour + materials. Context only. QUOTE_REQUIRED.

services.description: Bringing an existing non-compliant installation up to current Moroccan electrical standards.
services.candidacy_rationale: PERMANENTLY REJECTED — every non-compliant installation is unique. Scope defined only after full inspection. May require: new tableau, earthing, differential protection, cable replacement, additional circuits. Always QUOTE_REQUIRED.

reference_price.note: Context range from mano.ma. Wide range reflects variability. Useful for client budget expectation only.

services.description: Emergency electrical call-out outside standard hours.
services.candidacy_rationale: NOT YET — urgency modifier not approved. Evidence exists for surcharge ranges but FIXEO policy is urgency_modifier=null until transaction data confirms. Noted for future phase.

reference_price.note: Context only. Urgency intervention covers diagnostic only — repair quoted separately.

urgency_evidence.afous_urgency_hourly: 150–180 DH/h (P30-P70, 480 relevés — base rate, not emergency premium)
urgency_evidence.comparison_to_plumbing_legacy: Electricity urgency modifiers are MATERIALLY HIGHER than FIXEO legacy plumbing modifiers (+40%/+25%/+20%). Safety/risk factor commands larger premium.
urgency_evidence.note: All modifiers remain NON-CANONICAL. FIXEO must label: 'indicatif — tarif artisan prévalent'.
